Strategy: Raise the sweet-band reward to thirty while keeping the mid penalty at thirty, testing whether a stronger pull toward residuals between thirty and forty-five improves on the earlier winner. This may sharpen the preference for reusable leftovers, but the larger bonus may override tight fits that Best Fit would choose well.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (30 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
